title: koanophyllon consanguineum
intro: Koanophyllon consanguineum, commonly known as the "red-flowered tree" or "tree of life," is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Koanophyllon consanguineum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which may help to reduce inflammation, modulate immune responses, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
